name: codex-computer-use-pipe
description: Desktop control via Computer Use named pipe + Chrome/Edge automation via CDP for sessions running non-OpenAI models (e.g. deepseek-v4-flash).

interface.shortDescription: Desktop control (pipe) + browser dev-testing (CDP) for custom models.
interface.longDescription: Control Windows apps through the Computer Use named-pipe protocol and drive Chrome/Edge via CDP (navigate, click, type, read DOM, screenshots, console logs) when the built-in computer-use / browser MCP tools are unavailable in custom-model sessions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $codex-computer-use-pipe to control the desktop or drive the browser for dev self-testing.
